name: RRCL Cashflow vs Expected
query:
WITH
actual AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        SUM(credit) AS actual_inflows,
        SUM(debit)  AS actual_outflows,
        SUM(credit - debit) AS actual_netflow,
        COUNT(*) AS actual_transactions
    FROM `tabRRCL Cashflow`
    GROUP BY date
),

expected AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'INFLOW'  THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS expected_inflows,
        SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'OUTFLOW' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS expected_outflows,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN direction = 'INFLOW'  THEN amount
                WHEN direction = 'OUTFLOW' THEN -amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS expected_netflow,
        COUNT(*) AS expected_transactions
    FROM `tabRRCL Expected Cashflow`
    GROUP BY date
),

dates AS (
    SELECT date FROM actual
    UNION
    SELECT date FROM expected
)

SELECT
    d.date,

    -- Actual
    IFNULL(a.actual_inflows, 0)  AS actual_inflows,
    IFNULL(a.actual_outflows, 0) AS actual_outflows,
    IFNULL(a.actual_netflow, 0)  AS actual_netflow,
    

    -- Expected
    IFNULL(e.expected_inflows, 0)  AS expected_inflows,
    IFNULL(e.expected_outflows, 0) AS expected_outflows,
    IFNULL(e.expected_netflow, 0)  AS expected_netflow,
    

    -- Differences (Actual - Expected)
    IFNULL(a.actual_inflows, 0)  - IFNULL(e.expected_inflows, 0)  AS inflows_diff,
    IFNULL(a.actual_outflows, 0) - IFNULL(e.expected_outflows, 0) AS outflows_diff,
    IFNULL(a.actual_netflow, 0)  - IFNULL(e.expected_netflow, 0)  AS netflow_diff,
    IFNULL(a.actual_transactions, 0) AS actual_transactions,
    IFNULL(e.expected_transactions, 0) AS expected_transactions

FROM dates d
LEFT JOIN actual a   ON a.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN expected e ON e.date = d.date
ORDER BY d.date;
